Class TBinaryArchiveReader

Namespace
TuiVision.Serialization
Assembly
TuiVision.Serialization.dll

Schmale Binär-Reader-Abstraktion, die zu TBinaryArchiveWriter passt. Kapselt einen BinaryReader mit fester UTF-8-Kodierung.

Thin binary reader abstraction matching TBinaryArchiveWriter. Wraps a BinaryReader with fixed UTF-8 encoding.

public sealed class TBinaryArchiveReader : IDisposable
